summary: Pharming Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting its second quarter and first half 2026 financial results and revising year-end guidance. The filing discloses Q2 2026 total revenues of US$90.2 million, a 3% decrease, with RUCONEST revenue at US$72.3 million and Joenja revenue at US$17.9 million. The company updated 2026 total revenue guidance to US$375-395 million, a US$30 million reduction, and improved operating expense guidance by US$15 million. No special-situation corporate event is present; this is a routine financial results disclosure.
